standards_review.notes: All 8 subjects in the review range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format (EPMCDME-15401: ...)
Apache header and future annotations present; signatures typed with X | None and parameterized generics. Ruff and license-check were not run (read-only review).

security-patterns.md Untyped Input Handling forbids lossy repair before parsing; tool_call_channel.py:141 decodes script-written request bytes with utf-8 'replace' before json.loads. No secrets or shell interpolation found.

finding_status.notes: parse_tool_calling_timeout now catches (ValueError, OverflowError) and falls back to the 120 s default with a warning.
tool_calling_run log moved into a finally around _run_locked, so timed-out and failed runs log lock_wait and lock_hold.
Channel-less runs get a pre_run hook (sweep_stale_exchange_folders) executed inside the pod lock; wired from execute_workspace_script_tool.py.
_run_locked now stops the channel and cleans up with kill=True on any exception escaping session.run; non-kill cleanup only on the success path.
The min_remaining branch of _is_session_healthy checks the per-pod lock and leaves an executing session open, returning not-reusable instead of closing it.
Poll script decodes strictly and reports bad_encoding, answered as bad_request; KILL_SCRIPT decodes ascii strictly and exits 0 on UnicodeDecodeError.
SANDBOX_CMDLINE_MARKER is now imported from llm_sandbox.SANDBOX_SYSTEM_FILE_PREFIX, so a rename cannot silently disable the kill.

Response write is length-prefixed (reads exactly N bytes, no EOF needed), stdin sent as binary frames, and the exec read loop has a deadline that raises TimeoutError. Real-exec proof stays with Stage 7 (AC1).
_run catches ExecFailed and any Exception and writes the unavailable marker the SDK polls; _build_response is total and answers internal_error; _parse_request also catches RecursionError.
Housekeeping execs use _exec(interruptible=False), which backs off with time.sleep instead of the already-set stop event.
